task.title: Homepage rework: three-word hero (Свобода · стабильность · независимость) with a synced illustration panel and a minimal action-driven page (design stage first — canon ~/upready/packages/geist-kit/AGENTS.md for tokens and spacing; concept+copy doc artifacts/docs/2026-09-13-homepage-concept.md; working HTML prototype artifacts/docs/2026-09-13-homepage-prototype.html that DEMONSTRATES the hero word cycle and panel swap in a browser; human-eyes acceptance by Ivan on the live stand)
task.details:
GOAL. Replace the current generic landing (apps/homepage/port, a 1:1 port of the legacy 'plan B' page) with a fully reworked page whose every block pushes the visitor to one action: start a store. Headline (Ivan's choice, verbatim): «Свобода, стабильность и независимость начинаются здесь». Hero: the headline on the left; on the right a panel that shows, in sync with the highlighted word, an illustration conveying what that word means for THIS product. Page must be simple, minimal, low-noise, easy to read, no filler, with a short path to the action.

INPUTS. (a) Ivan's brief of 2026-09-13 07:2x WITA (this session): Свобода = the owner decides what to add/remove (open Medusa engine), manages the store from a phone via web or via a chat agent that can do anything the admin can (generate an image, translate pages, swap images, change block variants); blocks ship with pre-built variants, the agent edits only a config, every change is versioned and revertible; image generation via replicate/fal/evolink, one product-photo model. Стабильность = Ivan has no idea yet — asked me to develop it (own site vs marketplaces that change rules, ban categories, go bankrupt). Независимость = independence from the platform. Ivan asked me to think deeply, develop the keywords and CHANGE them if a sharper word conveys the product better. (b) Research reports written tonight by 8 readers: ~/upready/research/reports/2026-09-13-upready-store-product-strengths/*.md — strengths that can be built fast and well, taken from Ivan's reference projects (upready-studio, ui-upready-dev-monorepo, packshot/image-studio, chrxnasdmds chat/telegram/theme, upready-store today, market facts). (c) Competitor nav research artifacts/research/2026-09-12-competitor-nav-shopify-insales/.

DESIGN STAGE (first deliverable, before any .tsx edit). Canon: ~/upready/packages/geist-kit/AGENTS.md (rule 27) for tokens, type scale (display: 20-48px, weight 600, negative tracking), spacing and the one-accent rule; the ported page's Inter/#fafafa chrome stays the visual reference for rhythm. Deliverables: (1) artifacts/docs/2026-09-13-homepage-concept.md — keyword development (kept or changed, with the reasoning), page structure block by block with the copy, the CTA logic, the illustration brief per word, and an honesty table: each claim on the page -> the code/branch that backs it; (2) artifacts/docs/2026-09-13-homepage-prototype.html — a WORKING self-contained HTML prototype that DEMONSTRATES in a browser the hero word cycle, hover pinning and the panel swap for all three words, plus the whole page flow top to bottom. Ivan sees these before/with the React work.

RESOLVED DECISIONS. 1. Every claim on the page must be backed by code that exists (merged or on a named branch) or by a verified primary source; anything else is cut, not softened. 2. Social proof of Medusa's enterprise clients (Eight Sleep, Heineken…) is removed: it is not our proof. 3. Tariffs and prices stay as the funnel sells them (4 900 / 9 900 ₽ per apps/storefront/src/lib/demo/catalog.ts) unless the funnel says otherwise; the CTA leads into the /start funnel via lib/funnel.ts. 4. Hero cycle: 4 s per word, cross-fade 250 ms; hover/focus pins, leaving resumes; click pins until next click; below 768 px the panel moves under the headline; prefers-reduced-motion = no cycle, first word shown. 5. The hero stops being a 1:1 port; reference/shots/hero.png is not a baseline anymore; other sections that survive keep their look unless the concept changes them. 6. Illustrations: vector/CSS/SVG compositions or real product screenshots, not stock; no generated imagery on the page without a source note. 7. Work lands through a task branch feature/homepage-rework in a Superset workspace from dev and a GitHub PR merged by the acceptor (s8); Ivan gave blanket authorisation on 2026-09-13 for self-approval and merge.

ACCEPTANCE. Machine: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit clean; vite build clean; zero console errors in Playwright on load and after clicking every CTA and every hero word; all CTAs resolve to the funnel URL; no 'todo:' placeholder text visible anywhere on the page. Human eyes (Ivan, live stand, 18f): (a) reading the page top to bottom takes under two minutes and every block answers 'why act now'; (b) the hero highlights exactly one word at a time, the panel changes with it and the hero height does not jump; (c) each of the three illustrations reads as its word without the caption; (d) at 390 px nothing is clipped, no horizontal scroll, the panel sits under the headline; (e) no block on the page feels like filler — Ivan can name what he would remove and it is less than one block; (f) the CTA is visible above the fold at 1440 and 390 px.

SCOPE. apps/homepage/port/** (sections may be deleted, rewritten or added; registry and layout config updated accordingly), artifacts/docs/2026-09-13-homepage-concept.md, artifacts/docs/2026-09-13-homepage-prototype.html. Payment and onboarding screens are a SEPARATE task/branch if time allows.
